rootCause: Welcome codes were 75 characters but the upstream redeem-code entity and database allow 32.
fixedBehavior: New requests persist stable 32-character codes before upstream effects.
Legacy pending reservations migrate only after an exact complete empty old-code lookup.
Claimed and review reservations are not automatically replaced.
Claim failures refresh status without another automatic claim.
Stale session responses cannot clear or expose a newer account.
Logout clears the UI before subsequent network reads.

production.balanceValidation: Authenticated member and administrator reads agree. Net balance difference is not used as credit proof because the account has concurrent usage; the exact consumed receipt is authoritative.

scope: One existing user-initiated welcome request was resumed. Offline tests issued no production credits. No new member keys or model inference requests were created.
